title: Premium My PC viewer and input controls added
summary: Replace the basic remote desktop page with a responsive immersive viewer supporting rotation, touchpad input, keyboard controls, clipboard opt-in, quality presets and reconnect behavior.

changes.detail: Add landscape-friendly fullscreen viewport, auto-hiding toolbar, zoom/pan and safe-area styling.
Add direct-touch and precision-touchpad gestures, two-finger scroll/pinch, right-click, drag locking, special keys, modifiers, clipboard opt-in and adaptive quality controls.
Expire pairing codes after ten minutes, add bounded reconnect and visible Windows session activity, and expose gateway health measurements without claiming FPS.

validation.name: Automated checks
validation.detail: Run focused bridge, client and coordinate-mapping checks after implementation.
